mac-arm64.note: Mach-O LC_BUILD_VERSION minos 26.0 (otool -l): this helper is what sets the shipped macOS app and plugin to macOS 26.0 or later. The helper inside the 0.6.0-preview.11 macOS app (Contents/Helpers/ffmpeg). Its configure flags are identical to recorded-build-mac.sh in the sources archive. A read-only comparison found that every byte before its code signature (the first 4,499,120 bytes) is identical to the helper (sha256 e6c2345a6ebff28e60e2e201bef7589cc4e4f686996ec3a2663adf3c17b7d973) in an earlier preview.4 macOS package (a locally distributed test ZIP, never publicly released), with the same length and Mach-O UUID; only the signature differs. That comparison does not involve the earlier helper recorded below and does not show that the sources archive reproduces this binary; a bit-for-bit reproduction from the sources archive has not been verified.
